summary: This paper resolves four major open analytic questions left by Rodriguez Hertz, Rodriguez Hertz, and Wu (2026) regarding the ergodicity of geodesic flows on nonpositively curved surfaces. The author establishes: (1) strict regularity extension of metric curvature from C^{3+Lip} to C^{3+LogLip_{3/2}} and the full 2/3-Dini-Osgood hierarchy; (2) exact non-asymptotic Guillemin-Kazhdan-Kannai constants with explicit rational bounds (CRHRHW in (3.32, 3.33)); (3) a sharp anisotropic Sobolev-Hölder phase diagram alpha_crit(sigma) = max(0, (1-6sigma)/(1+2sigma)); and (4) matching sharp Parseval-summable obstructions proving unimprovability. All results are fully formalized in Lean 4.36.0 (20 theorems, zero sorry) and verified via exact rational arithmetic.
